reason: An Electron desktop wrapper for the dsh Web UI with custom window chrome, system tray controls, URL handling, and optional automatic startup of the dsh web server.

summaries.zh: 将 dsh Web UI 封装为带自定义标题栏和系统托盘功能的 Electron 桌面应用。
summaries.en: Wraps the dsh Web UI in an Electron desktop application with a custom title bar and system tray controls.

capabilities: Loads a web UI in an Electron desktop window
Provides a frameless window with a custom themed title bar
Provides system tray controls for showing the window, opening a browser, and exiting
Parses a URL and can start the dsh web server and Electron as child processes
